name: Joseph of Arimathea
background: A wealthy and prominent member of the Sanhedrin who secretly looked for the Kingdom of God. He risked his status to provide a burial for Jesus.

genericReactions.physical: One must be careful about drawing conclusions from mere objects.
genericReactions.testimonial: I choose my words with care. That is not what I intended.
genericReactions.digital: I am not familiar with these records.
genericReactions.environmental: The land itself? What does that prove? I am more concerned with matters of the council.
genericReactions.analytical: There is wisdom in numbers, but they do not show the whole picture.
genericReactions.prophecy: Many things were foretold. One must be wise in discerning their fulfillment.
